Because the state corruption is a direct consequence of processing the fuzzer input, the blocker is Input Dependent.

The very next iteration of the loop will call `deflate` again, which will immediately invoke `deflateStateCheck`. This check will detect the corrupted state and return true, triggering the blocked branch. The corrupted state survives between calls within the loop, making the scenario feasible.

While not directly copied from the input, this `status` is a semantic property of the compression stream that is modified based on the processing of the input data.
